name: Canon EOS R3 High-Speed Action Crisp
author: Vimona Core
system_instructions: Use `shot on Canon EOS R3, 70-200mm f/2.8 lens, 1/2000s fast shutter speed`: freeze flying chalk dust, muscle tension veins, and water spray mid-air against compressed stadium bokeh.

name: Leica M11 35mm Summilux Street
author: Vimona Core
system_instructions: Invoke rangefinder immediacy: `Leica M11 aesthetic, 35mm Summilux f/1.4, tactile micro-contrast, deep punchy shadows, intimate street distance`, unvarnished candid timing.

name: Nikon Z8 600mm Super-Telephoto Wildlife
author: Vimona Core
system_instructions: Specify `600mm f/4 super-telephoto prime`: paper-thin focal plane isolating individual wet fur strands or feather barbules crisply against silky painterly autumn/snow bokeh.

name: 50mm f/1.2 G-Master Modern Editorial
author: Vimona Core
system_instructions: Pair `50mm f/1.2 prime, clinical edge-to-edge eye sharpness, razor eyelash resolution, smooth cat-eye peripheral bokeh, crisp natural skin tones` for modern high-budget portrait campaigns.

name: Hasselblad X2D 100C Medium Format
author: Vimona Core
system_instructions: Use `Hasselblad X2D 100C, XCD 90mm f/2.5`: uncanny three-dimensional subject pop (`medium-format spatial separation`), subtle 16-bit highlight roll-off, rich unclipped fabric and skin tones.

name: Fujifilm GFX 100S Alpine Drama
author: Vimona Core
system_instructions: Channel `Fujifilm GFX 100S, GF 32-64mm f/4`: ultra-clean rocky granite crevices, subtle cool-teal frost shadow undertones balancing luminous golden alpine cloud highlights.

name: Fujichrome Velvia 50 Slide Vibrance
author: Vimona Core
system_instructions: Apply `Fujichrome Velvia 50 reversal slide film`: deep dense shadow blacks, rich saturated moss greens and terracotta canyons, luminous crisp sky gradients for fine-art nature scenes.

name: Kodak Tri-X 400 Gritty Press Grain
author: Vimona Core
system_instructions: Specify `Kodak Tri-X 400 black and white film pushed one stop`: prominent punchy silver grain, smoky jazz/alley contrast, expressive raw street energy.

name: Kodak Ektar 100 Coastal Punch
author: Vimona Core
system_instructions: Infuse `Kodak Ektar 100 crisp ultra-fine grain`: clean vibrant cobalt sea water, crisp chalk-white limestone cottages, punchy red umbrellas, and sunny contrast.

name: Polaroid SX-70 Instant Pastel Glow
author: Vimona Core
system_instructions: Channel `vintage Polaroid SX-70 instant print`: lifted creamy milky blacks, warm nostalgic magenta-amber highlight drift, gentle lens edge softness, intimate summer dusk feel.

name: 1860s Wet-Plate Collodion Tintype
author: Vimona Core
system_instructions: Render authentic `wet-plate collodion silver ferrotype`: razor-sharp central Petzval eye plane, bright spectral cyan-silver eyes, swirling periphery blur, subtle silver nitrate chemical pour edges.

name: Helios 44-2 58mm Swirly Bokeh
author: Vimona Core
system_instructions: Use `Helios 44-2 58mm f/2 vintage Soviet optics`: crisp centered face enveloped inside luminous elliptical swirling leaf/fairy-light bokeh vortex along edges.

name: 85mm f/2.2 Petzval Brass Spiral
author: Vimona Core
system_instructions: Invoke `Lomography Petzval 85mm brass art lens`: glowing sweet-spot center sharpness with intense swirling radial bokeh falloff and subtle warm vintage brass flare.

name: 28mm f/2.8 Street Context Balance
author: Vimona Core
system_instructions: Frame closely via `28mm f/2.8 wide-normal lens` keeping foreground human gesture intimate while wide doorway signage, passing cars, and upper architecture remain sharp in context.

name: 16mm Circular Drama & Action
author: Vimona Core
system_instructions: Anchor `low 16mm ultra-wide fisheye optics inches below airborne sneaker/skateboard or microphone`, bending concrete pool coping and sunset palm skyline cleanly inward.

name: 45mm Tilt-Shift Miniature Effect
author: Vimona Core
system_instructions: Shoot from high rooftop perch with `45mm tilt-shift selective focus slice`: narrow crisp middle ribbon of colorful harbor boats/trams sandwiched between creamy blurred top and bottom zones.

name: 135mm f/1.8 Background Compression
author: Vimona Core
system_instructions: Isolate solitary subject effortlessly inside busy downtown crowds via `135mm f/1.8 telephoto`: tight framing, distant city headlights blooming into huge buttery discs behind crisp hair.

name: Kodak Aerochrome Crimson Infrared
author: Vimona Core
system_instructions: Emulate `Kodak Aerochrome false-color infrared film`: lush summer forest foliage glowing vibrant magenta-crimson against deep crisp cobalt sky and bright stark chalk clouds.

name: Rolleiflex Twin-Lens Waist-Level 6×6
author: Vimona Core
system_instructions: Shoot from slightly low calm waist-level perspective (`Rolleiflex 2.8F, Planar 80mm, gentle natural daylight`), capturing poised timeless documentary dignity.

name: Direct On-Camera Hard Pop Flash
author: Vimona Core
system_instructions: Use `35mm point-and-shoot Contax T2 direct pop flash at night`: punchy frontal sheen along jacket/lip gloss casting tight crisp drop shadow immediately behind against dark club/street background.

name: Long-Exposure ND Filter Glass Water
author: Vimona Core
system_instructions: Specify `tripod-mounted 4-second ND1000 exposure`: velvet glassy mist swirling evenly around razor-sharp wet black moss boulders and crisp unmoving pine needles.

name: 1/30s Shutter Speed Drag Panning
author: Vimona Core
system_instructions: Keep motorcycle/coupe cabin tack-sharp (`1/30s tracked camera pan`) while asphalt guardrails, streetlights, and spoke wheels streak cleanly into linear horizontal motion trails.

name: 40mm 2× Anamorphic Cinema Frame
author: Vimona Core
system_instructions: Use `ARRI Alexa 35 aesthetic, Cooke Anamorphic 40mm f/2.0`: organic oval bokeh highlights, restrained warm/cyan film print LUT, and classic cinematic headroom.

name: Focus-Stacked Extreme Botanical/Insect Macro
author: Vimona Core
system_instructions: Render crisp edge-to-edge macro geometry (`100mm f/5.6 focus-stacked micro frame`): crystalline morning dew lenses refracting sunrise inside velvet petal ridges cleanly.

name: Holga 120N Dreamy Toy-Lens
author: Vimona Core
system_instructions: Embrace nostalgic plastic-lens charm: `deep corner darkening vignette, soft peripheral radial blur, faint warm amber edge light leak, tender poetic isolation`.
